workstream: P5 / AC1027 TABLECONTENT grouped cell border edge flags

basis.authoritativeSpecification: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.101.4.
basis.interpretation: The BL edgeFlags field defines six independent edge bits: top=0x01, right=0x02, bottom=0x04, left=0x08, inside vertical=0x10, and inside horizontal=0x20. Nonzero non-overlapping masks compose those defined edge bits into one border record.
basis.selectedProperty: Border property override bit 0x10 selects invisibility; value 1 means invisible.

profile.fixture: Runtime-authored 2x2 TABLECONTENT based on tableContentScalarGrid; no drawing fixture files were added.
profile.styleScope: One cell-style TABLEFORMAT with three disjoint grouped-edge GRIDFORMAT records.
profile.edgeCoverage: The masks cover all six ODA-defined edge bits exactly once.

implementation.behavior: The bounded TABLECONTENT writer accepts one through six nonzero edge masks within 0x3f when all selected borders use the qualified invisibility-only fields. Overlapping masks are refused; border property combinations outside invisibility remain refused.
implementation.physicalWire: The independent scalar observer checks the border count, each group-95 edge mask, GRIDFORMAT markers, property flags, default companions, group-93 invisibility value, and closing marker for both encodings.
implementation.typedReadback: Fresh ASCII and binary imports preserve the three grouped masks, their order, and selected border fields.
implementation.failureRetry: For each grouped profile and encoding, an unsupported property mask 0x40 is refused without replacing a sentinel destination or changing the caller model; restoring 0x10 allows retry and readback.
implementation.fixturePolicy: Runtime-authored recipe only; no external drawing fixtures were committed.

limits: Only the AC1027 TABLECONTENT serializer/readback profile is covered; this is not DWG TABLECONTENT output or other DXF version qualification.
Overlapping edge declarations and border-type/color/lineweight/linetype/double-line combinations remain refused or unqualified.
Wire and typed readback do not establish native rendering, producer completeness, whole-document closure, or public support claims.
next: Implement the next source- or consumer-backed CONTENTFORMAT, CELLSTYLEMAP, or distinct border-property profile; retain strict refusal outside admitted fields.
